reply_text:
I haven't sent anything to Ottilie yet because I can't find Florian's Dreyness Brewing Co. draft.

I checked my mail drafts and inbox, which are both empty, and the shared files. Those only have Florian's Sierra QBR plan and Moss's Sierra digests, with no Dreyness draft. None of the channels I looked at has a request from Florian about Dreyness going to Ottilie. I didn't want to rewrite it from guesswork and pass that off as the version June approved.

I replied to June in her DM and asked her or Florian to paste the draft or tell me where it is. Ottilie is internal (oellford@pemberline.com), so Ruth doesn't need to approve it. June's approval covers the finance side, since the Sierra channel shows the Dreyness renewal offer includes a discount.

One correction to my reply: I wrote that I'd "send" it to Ottilie. I can only save mail as a draft, and a person has to hit send. Once I have the text, I'll save it as a draft addressed to Ottilie and tell June it's ready.
